_doc: TEMPLATE ENCOUNTERS. 'party' lists character ids from characters/ (empty = use the active campaign party). 'enemies' instantiate templates from enemies/enemies.json with per-instance overrides. bossPhases fire once when the referenced enemy drops below hpBelow: they can announce (bannerText/narrationText), crush the party toward reducePartyToHpPct (executing anyone under executeBelowHpPct), and/or summon reinforcements. midBattleJoin adds a character to the party after N enemy actions.
